promptText: What tool matches this description: "The next gen of notes & docs. Simple. Powerful. Beautiful."?
rawText:
The tool that matches this description is **Craft** (also known as **Craft Docs** or **Craft.do**). 

It is a popular note-taking and document creation app known for its sleek design, block-based editor, and strong integration across Apple platforms (iOS/Mac), Windows, and the web.
